title: AI-powered levers of control in implementing CSR strategies for enhanced overall performance: the case of financial institutions in Morocco
core_idea: The study examines how management control systems—framed by Simons' levers of control and enhanced by AI tools—shape the implementation of CSR strategies and relate to multidimensional overall performance (economic, social, environmental) in Moroccan financial institutions, using an integrated Simons–Reynaud conceptual framework and empirical data collected via a structured questionnaire and analyzed with PLS-SEM.
tldr: Investigates the role of AI-enhanced management control levers in embedding CSR and their relation to overall (economic, social, environmental) performance in Moroccan financial institutions using a questionnaire and PLS-SEM within a combined Simons–Reynaud framework.
